Name: Glitch Coffee & Roasters
Hours: Weekdays 8:00–19:00, weekends 9:00–19:00; no fixed closing days
Address (JA): 東京都千代田区神田錦町3-16
Notes: Original Glitch (2015) and roastery for all locations. Light-roast single origins only; the pour-over flight is the popular order. Expect queues, especially weekends. Short walk from Book Hotel Jimbocho.

Name: Glitch Coffee
Address (JA): 東京都中央区銀座4-14-8
Notes: Opened 2023; beans roasted at Jimbocho. Card only, no cash. Waits of 20–60 min at peak; go at weekday opening. Also serves coffee cocktails.

Name: Glitch Tokyo
Address (JA): 東京都中央区日本橋本町1-1-3 立石本町ビル1F
Notes: Glitch's Nihonbashi outpost. Details not yet verified.

Name: Turret Coffee
Address (JA): 東京都中央区築地2-12-6 SK東銀座ビル1F
Notes: An espresso-focused shop run by Kiyoshi Kawasaki (ex-Streamer Coffee), named after the Tsukiji market carts, with one inside the shop. Order the signature Turret Latte (a double shot), a seasonal latte, or the Kawasaki Latte with Yamazaki whisky. Only a few seats; it's near the Tsukiji outer market and lyf Ginza.

Name: Passage Coffee
Address (JA): 東京都港区芝5-14-16
Notes: Run by Shuichi Sasaki, 2014 World AeroPress Champion. Near Tokyo Tower (Mita). Hours not yet verified.

Name: Ogawa Coffee Laboratory
Address (JA): 東京都港区高輪2-21-1 THE LINKPILLAR 2 (NEWoMan高輪 MIMURE) 2F
Notes: Ogawa's 12-'lab' food complex in Takanawa Gateway City (opened Mar 2026): coffee, bakery, gelato, pizza, beer. Your pin is KURA:000, the grocery lab (beans, drip bags); the coffee bar is CUP:092 in the same complex.

Name: Koffee Mameya Kakeru
Address (JA): 東京都江東区平野2-16-14
Notes: Course-style coffee tasting at a counter (roughly ¥3,500–7,000). Book up to 1 month ahead; no same-day bookings; 1h45m seating; groups of 4 max; cancellation fee within 24h. Sister to Koffee Mameya Omotesando, the original shop.

Name: Fuglen
Address (JA): 東京都台東区浅草2-6-15
Notes: Larger than the Tomigaya original. Ground floor of the Nine Hours capsule hotel, west of Senso-ji. Cocktails and natural wine in the evening.

Name: Unlimited Coffee Bar
Address (JA): 東京都墨田区業平1-18-2
Notes: Founded in 2012 by baristas Daichi Matsubara and Rena Hirai, it began as a barista training lab. Coffee cocktails too: cold brew tonic, espresso martini. Next to Skytree; the roastery is in Arakawa.

Name: Coffee Elementary School
Address (JA): 東京都墨田区錦糸4-9-9 宮本マンション2 102
Notes: Private Coffee Elementary School' (私立珈琲小学校). Schoolhouse concept, formerly in Daikanyama, now Kinshicho. Sumida Blend in light or dark roast; signature coffee-jelly soft serve. Hours not yet verified.

Name: Leaves Coffee Roasters
Address (JA): 東京都墨田区本所1-8-8
Notes: Ryogoku/Honjo roastery café; a queue often forms at opening. Panama Geisha sometimes on the menu. Sister stand Leaves Coffee Apartment is in Komagata (Kuramae side).

Name: ARC
Address (JA): 東京都台東区鳥越2-3-4 1F
Notes: Opened 2023 opposite Torigoe Shrine. Owner Haruhiko Nishioka built the arched counter and tube amps himself; jazz on vintage speakers. Bold, darker-roast coffee; signature cheese tart; natural wine and craft beer at night.

Name: Koffee Mameya
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区神宮前4丁目
Notes: The original Mameya. Standing counter with 15–25 roasts curated from Japanese and international roasters; staff guide you through the beans. Optional priority-arrival booking (small fee); 45-min max stay. No course menu (that's Kakeru).

Name: Sedai Coffee and Roasters
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神宮前5-29-9 1F
Notes: Newer roaster in Jingumae 5-chome; second shop in Hatagaya. Details not yet verified.

Name: Obscura
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区道玄坂1-12-1 東急フードショー B1F
Notes: In Tokyu Food Show B1F, 1 min from Shibuya station gates. Mainly beans plus takeaway drinks; no seating.

Name: Cafe Reissue
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神宮前3-25-7
Notes: Famous 2D/3D latte art: bring a photo and they'll recreate it in foam. Hours not yet verified.

Name: Higuma Doughnuts × Coffee Wrights
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区神宮前4丁目
Notes: Doughnut shop paired with Coffee Wrights coffee (Coffee Wrights roasts in Kuramae). Hours not yet verified.

Name: About Life Coffee Brewers
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区渋谷1丁目
Notes: Onibus's sister brand; compact standing bar using Onibus-roasted beans. Hours not yet verified.

Name: White Glass Coffee
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区桜丘町
Notes: Run by Green Bean to Bar Chocolate, with drinks served in white glass cups. Have the avocado toast or the tiramisu; the bread comes from Green Thumb, the bakery next door.

Name: Fuglen
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区富ヶ谷1-16-11
Notes: Oslo café's first overseas outpost (2012). Nordic light roast by day; creative cocktail bar from ~19:00. Vintage Scandinavian furniture. Benches out front.

Name: Coffee Supreme Tokyo
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神山町42-3 1F
Notes: Tokyo shop of the Wellington, New Zealand roaster, in Kamiyamacho near Yoyogi Park.

Name: Little Nap Coffee Stand
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区代々木5-65-4
Notes: The original Little Nap (2011), opposite Yoyogi Park's west gate, with a strong music and DJ culture. Bagels, hot dogs and muffins go with the coffee. Few seats, so take your coffee into the park.

Name: Little Nap Coffee Roasters
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区富ヶ谷2-43-15
Notes: Roastery shop (2017) in a white-tiled building; a bit roomier than the Stand. Sandwiches, hot dogs, cakes. Record shop upstairs.

Name: nadoya no katte
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区西原3丁目
Notes: Details not yet verified.

Name: Sedai Coffee
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区幡ヶ谷1丁目
Notes: Sedai's second shop. Details not yet verified.

Name: All Seasons Coffee
Address (JA): 東京都新宿区新宿2-7-7 寿ビル1F
Notes: Since 2015 (formerly '4/4 Seasons Coffee'), run by Jun and Emi Saito. Famous custard pudding; toast and cakes. Tabelog Cafe 100 pick. Small (~14 seats), a conversation spot rather than a laptop café. Near Shinjuku Gyoen.

Name: Alternative Coffee Works
Address (JA): ~東京都新宿区北新宿4丁目
Notes: Details not yet verified.

Name: Onibus Coffee
Address (JA): 東京都目黒区上目黒2-14-1
Notes: Onibus's flagship (2016): two-story renovated wooden house by the tracks, counter downstairs and seating upstairs, park next door. Onibus was founded 2012 by Atsushi Sakao and is a pioneer of Japanese light-roast specialty.

Name: Onibus Coffee
Address (JA): ~東京都目黒区中目黒3丁目 (SANU NOWHERE)
Notes: Newest shop (Sep 2024) inside the SANU NOWHERE lounge on Komazawa-dori, ~10 min from the station, on the former Blue Bottle Nakameguro site. Better for lingering. Note: your old pin labeled this 'Main Shop', but the flagship is the station-front shop.

Name: Onibus Coffee
Address (JA): ~東京都目黒区八雲4丁目
Notes: Home of the Onibus roastery since 2019, with a small stand and seating. Residential area near Toritsu-daigaku.

Name: Onibus Coffee
Address (JA): 東京都目黒区緑が丘2-24-8 arbre自由が丘
Notes: Opened 2022; the first Onibus with a kitchen (brunch, plated desserts). Terrace seating; busy at brunch even on weekdays.

Name: Sidewalk Stand
Address (JA): ~東京都目黒区青葉台1丁目
Notes: Details not yet verified.

Name: little cloud coffee
Address (JA): ~東京都目黒区青葉台1丁目
Notes: Details not yet verified.

Name: Obscura
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区三軒茶屋1-36-10
Notes: ~1 min from Sangenjaya station. Relocated and reopened in 2024 with the brand's full bean lineup; also sells flowers and pottery. Obscura is a Sangenjaya specialty pioneer founded by Hiroshima natives.

Name: Obscura
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区太子堂4-28-9
Notes: Opened Dec 2011 on Chazawa-dori between Sangenjaya and Shimokitazawa. Takeaway, espresso-focused; standing tables on the street when Chazawa-dori is pedestrianized on weekends.

Name: Obscura
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区若林1-2-1
Notes: Obscura's shop for beans, brewing gear and gifts, with ten-plus origins to drink as hand drip or espresso. There's a barista training room in the back.

Name: Bear Pond Espresso
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区北沢2-36-12
Notes: Katsu Tanaka's cult espresso bar (2009), where only Tanaka touches the machine. The Angel Stain ristretto runs to ten or so a day, served only until early afternoon and only when Tanaka is in. Strict house rules: no photos, no laptops.

Name: Ogawa Coffee Laboratory
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区新町3-23-8 エスカリエ桜新町1F
Notes: Tokyo flagship (2020) of Kyoto's 70+-year-old Ogawa Coffee. 21+ coffees; choose espresso, pour-over or AeroPress. Signature KURA bean cellar; roasts in store. Morning menu. Often a line.

Name: Ogawa Coffee Laboratory
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区北沢3-19-20 reload 1-1
Notes: In the reload complex. Brew-it-yourself bar with ~40 brewing devices; 11 tastable single origins plus 10 blends. Scones.

Name: Cloud Club Matcha
Address (JA): 東京都中央区銀座3-14-6
Notes: Tiny takeout-only matcha stand that went viral, with the matcha whisked to order in front of you. Order the premium matcha latte (first-flush leaves, oat milk available) or the hojicha latte. Queues of thirty or more at lunchtime; arrive at opening. Cards, IC and QR pay.

Name: Cloud Club Matcha
Address (JA): 東京都中央区銀座1-20-10 GYBトマトハウス1F
Notes: Second stand, opened March 2026 near Shintomicho: the same drinks with a shorter line and five standing seats. The shop posts closures on Instagram.

Name: Latte Art Mania Tokyo
Address (JA): 東京都港区北青山2-9-13 斉藤ビル1F
Notes: Competition-level latte art from four-time Japanese champion Kenta Baba, a minute from Gaienmae station. The LATTEMANI BLACK (bamboo-charcoal latte with kuromitsu) is the signature; the matcha latte, whisked to order with Hatoya's Kyoto matcha, makes it a tea stop too. Eleven seats, weekend queues; latte-art classes booked on Instagram.

Name: The Matcha Tokyo
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神宮前1-13-18
Notes: Five-storey flagship opened November 2025 in front of JR Harajuku: café, a reservation-only tea room on the fifth floor and a yoga space on the fourth. Organic Kagoshima matcha whisked to order; the matcha latte and the wasanbon matcha ice cream. Cashless only; five-language menu.

Name: The Matcha Tokyo
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神宮前5-11-13
Notes: The original shop (2018), on Cat Street since a 2023 move: counter downstairs, tables upstairs, twenty-five seats. Matcha latte, matcha lemonade and wagashi; retail tins for souvenirs. Cashless only.

Name: The Matcha Tokyo
Address (JA): 東京都新宿区新宿4-1-6 NEWoMan新宿1F
Notes: Six-seat stand on the ground floor of NEWoMan at the south exit of Shinjuku Station, the brand's second shop (2019). Takeout drinks and sweets; expect a short queue. Cards, IC and QR pay.

Name: The Matcha Tokyo
Address (JA): 東京都墨田区押上1-1-2 東京スカイツリータウン・ソラマチ1F
Notes: Forty-seat café on the first floor of Solamachi's East Yard under the Skytree, the nearest branch to Asakusa. The same organic matcha drinks and sweets, open late.

Name: Atelier Matcha
Hours: Daily 9:00–18:00 (last order 17:45); closed over New Year
Address (JA): 東京都中央区銀座8-18-4 東銀座ビル1F
Notes: First café of Yamamasa Koyamaen, a 160-year-old Uji matcha maker; moved from Ningyocho to Ginza 8-chome in 2023, near Tsukiji-shijo station. Ceremonial-grade Ogurayama matcha latte (oat or soy available), matcha tiramisu and gateau; sells matcha, tea gear and an electric whisk. Twenty-four seats, often full by late afternoon.

Name: Hatoya
Address (JA): 東京都台東区花川戸2-14-3
Notes: 八十八浅草, the Tokyo branch of Kyoto matcha stand 八十八良葉舎, in a renovated wooden house behind Sumida Park. Matcha lattes by grade, 壱 to 参 (¥800–1,600), with house matcha ice cream or shiratama; the Asakusa-only pudding sells out. Standing only; thirty to forty-five minute lines at weekends, so go early on a weekday. English menu.

Name: Hatoya
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神山町3-8 AISKビル1F
Notes: Second Tokyo shop (July 2025) in Kamiyama-cho near Yoyogi-koen station, on the Okushibu café strip. The same matcha grades, a hojicha latte, the Hatoya shake and financiers; eight bench seats, terrace allows dogs.

Name: Gokago
Address (JA): 京都府京都市東山区清水2-258
Notes: Matcha stand on Kiyomizu-zaka, the slope up to Kiyomizu-dera, with the matcha whisked in front of you. The rich matcha latte and the matcha ice-cream monaka are the orders; sells tins, whisks and tea ware. Lines form before opening and the wait can pass an hour; English spoken; cards and QR pay.

Name: Hoho Hojicha
Hours: Daily 10:00–18:00 (café last order 17:30); eat-in reservations by phone on weekdays only
Address (JA): 京都府宇治市宇治妙楽51-2
Notes: Kyoto's only hojicha-only tea house, on Uji's main shopping street five minutes from Keihan Uji on the way to Byodo-in. The hojicha sweets plate with a hojicha latte, or the gelato and pudding; take home the award-winning 悦びの焙じ茶. Twelve seats, one order per person and sets not shared; cards and IC pay.

Name: The Matcha Tokyo
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神宮前6-20-10 MIYASHITA PARK
Notes: Twenty-three-seat shop in the Miyashita Park complex on Meiji-dori, a few minutes from Shibuya Station; takeout available.

Name: The Matcha Tokyo
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区恵比寿南1-2-2 アトレ恵比寿本館3F
Notes: Seven-seat counter on the third floor of atre Ebisu, above the station; opened July 2026.

Name: Hatoya
Address (JA): 京都府京都市右京区嵯峨天龍寺造路町33
Notes: 八十八良葉舎's flagship (November 2024), a minute from Togetsukyo bridge, with a river-view terrace and a paid foot bath. Twelve seats inside and twenty on the terrace; the Arashiyama-only matcha latte set, shaved ice in summer. Not the original 2019 stand near Kurumazaki Shrine, two kilometres away.

Name: Hatoya
Address (JA): 京都府京都市東山区南町415-6
Notes: Hatoya's second Kyoto shop (October 2024), on the walk from Kodaiji to the Yasaka Pagoda, with standing tables only. Order the matcha or hojicha latte and the tea dango, steamed each morning. Look for it on Kodaiji Minamimon-dori near the Higashiyama-Yasui bus stop.

Name: Hoho Hojicha
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区東塩小路町901 京都駅ビル1F おみやげ小路 京小町
Notes: Retail counter in the Kyo-komachi souvenir street on the first floor of the station building: tea, syrup and sweets to take home, no drinks or seating.

Name: Hoho Hojicha
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区東塩小路釜殿町31-1 みやこみち内
Notes: Takeout-only stand in the Miyakomichi arcade at the Hachijo (south) exit, entered from outside; hojicha lattes and gelato for the shinkansen. Opened August 2025.

Name: About Life Coffee Brewers
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区道玄坂1-19-8
Notes: Onibus's original stand (2014) on Dogenzaka: a takeaway counter with a few benches, pouring Onibus plus guest roasters such as Switch and Amameria. Hours have shortened over the years; the official page is current.

Name: Coffee Wrights
Hours: Wed–Fri 11:00–16:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 10:00–17:30; closed Mon and Tue
Address (JA): 東京都台東区蔵前4-20-2
Notes: The roastery café behind the Omotesando doughnut shop, two minutes from Kuramae station: small and unpretentious, beans roasted on site. Short weekday hours.

Name: little cloud coffee
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神宮前5-10-1 GYRE 2F
Notes: The original little cloud (2014), a shop-in-shop stand inside visvim on the second floor of GYRE with about ten terrace seats over Omotesando.

Name: Ogawa Coffee Laboratory
Hours: Weekdays 8:00–20:00 (last order 19:30), weekends and holidays 10:00–20:00; closures follow Garden Plaza
Address (JA): 東京都港区麻布台1-2-4 麻布台ヒルズ ガーデンプラザC B1F
Notes: Bean salon in the Azabudai Hills Market: a dozen single origins, custom blends made up on the spot, and a counter to drink them at.

Name: Fuglen
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区代田4-36-14 1F
Notes: The quieter Fuglen, a café and bar by Hanegi Park near Umegaoka Station: coffee by day, cocktails in the evening.

Name: Fuglen
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区代々木4-20-10
Notes: Coffee-only Fuglen (January 2024) in a renovated old house near Sangubashi station: takeaway at the front and a reservation-only tasting counter at the back.

Name: Sidewalk Coffee Roasters
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区北沢3-9-19 マスタードホテル1F
Notes: Sidewalk's roastery (April 2021) on the ground floor of Mustard Hotel on the Shimokita rail-site redevelopment, two minutes from Higashi-Kitazawa: bagels, craft beer, indoor and terrace seats, power and Wi-Fi.

Name: Sidewalk Stand
Address (JA): 東京都目黒区祐天寺1-26-11 1F
Notes: Stand with an in-store bakery (baguette sandwiches, casse-croûte) on Yutenji's café street, since 2019.

Name: Passage Coffee
Address (JA): 東京都中央区日本橋堀留町2-10-9 MIMARU SUITES 東京日本橋 2F
Notes: Hotel-lounge café on the second floor of MIMARU Suites, open to non-guests, with tatami seating; three minutes from Ningyocho. Closes early on weekdays.

Name: Passage Coffee
Address (JA): 東京都新宿区市谷田町2-7-15
Notes: Passage's Ichigaya café, about 350 m from the station. The pin is block-level; the shop is at 2-7-15.

Name: Ogawa Coffee
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区堺町通錦小路上る菊屋町519-1
Notes: 小川珈琲's showcase café (2022) in a hundred-year-old machiya a step off Nishiki market, with a menu built on local ingredients. The Kyoto roaster behind the Tokyo Laboratories; opens at seven.

Name: Ogawa Coffee
Hours: 9:00–20:00 (last order 19:30); Sat and eves of holidays until 21:00
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区三条通河原町東入中島町96-2
Notes: Ogawa's café on Sanjo-dori just east of Kawaramachi, open late on Saturdays.

Name: Ogawa Coffee
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区塩小路通室町東入東塩小路町579-16 ホテル法華クラブ京都1F
Notes: Ground floor of the Hotel Hokke Club across from the central exit: the reliable early coffee before a train.

Name: Ogawa Coffee
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区東塩小路町 地下鉄京都駅コンコース中央1改札口北側 コトチカ京都902
Notes: Stand inside the subway concourse at Kotochika Kyoto, north of the central gates; for a cup on the way through.

Name: Ogawa Coffee
Address (JA): 京都府京都市東山区清水4-171 MUJI BASE KYOTO kiyomizu 1F
Notes: Opened May 2026 on the ground floor of MUJI's lodging on the Kiyomizu approach; breakfast is for guests, the café is open to all.

Name: Higuma Doughnuts × Coffee Wrights
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区備前島町310-2 立誠ガーデン ヒューリック京都内
Notes: Opened November 2024 in the former Rissei elementary school complex near Shijo-Kawaramachi: Higuma's doughnuts (a Kyoto-only matcha one) with Coffee Wrights coffee, and Mikkeller beer from the afternoon.

Name: Fuglen
Address (JA): 京都府京都市北区紫竹東栗栖町38-3 A HOUSE 1階
Notes: Fuglen's Kyoto shop in Shichiku, north of the centre, sharing a renovated fifty-year-old shop with a jewellery studio. No hours published yet; check before going.

Name: Acid Coffee Tokyo
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区上原1-29-5 ビット代々木上原101
Notes: Hand-drip coffee from thirty-plus beans, served in wine glasses, with a vinyl and B&W hi-fi setup. Seven or so seats, and cashless only.

Name: Ignis Coffee
Hours: 11:00–18:00; sometimes opens at night on full-moon days (see Instagram)
Address (JA): 東京都文京区千駄木3-44-11
Notes: The Tokyo branch of a cult Kamakura stand, selling rare fermented and auction-lot beans, ten or so single origins. Hand drip comes in matcha bowls; there's also coffee jelly and the 'Noir' fake mocha.

Name: Covert Coffee
Address (JA): 東京都新宿区新宿3-27-10 武蔵野ビルB1F
Notes: A quiet basement specialty café pouring light-roast single origins, Glitch Coffee beans among them. Some twenty seats; order at the counter.

Name: Apollon's Gold
Address (JA): ~東京都港区赤坂五丁目
Notes: A high-end roaster of rare micro-lots and Geishas. The Akasaka roastery café pulls its whole single-origin lineup on a DE1 machine and makes pour-overs with custom-profiled water, a modern take on the kissaten, at premium prices. It also runs a reservation-only omakase tasting lab, Kitanomaru Studio, near Kudanshita.

Name: Brewman Tokyo
Hours: 11:00–18:00 Mon, Fri, Sat, Sun; closed Tue, Wed, Thu
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区代々木3-13-1 SMI:RE YOYOGI 1F
Notes: Run by 2022 Japan Brewers Cup champion Hikaru Ono. Choose from ten-plus beans, light to dark, each brewed on the gear that suits it (cloth filter for the dark roasts), plus guest roasters.

Name: Cokuun
Address (JA): ~東京都港区北青山三丁目
Notes: A reservation-only coffee omakase at a four-seat counter inside a sculpture: a 90-minute course of six or so drinks, rare beans paired with seasonal ingredients and desserts. ¥19,800 per person, prepaid on TableCheck; the address comes with your booking, within ten minutes' walk of Omotesando Station.

Name: Lonich
Address (JA): 東京都台東区蔵前1-7-4 Kビル1F
Notes: Ten or so rare single-origin beans, plus coffee omakase courses (¥4,000–¥8,500, including a Geisha course). Book the courses in advance; walk in for single drinks, which are takeout only.

Name: Kurasu Kyoto Stand
Hours: 8:00–18:00 (last drink order 17:30); closed irregularly, see social media
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区東油小路町552
Notes: Kurasu's first café, five minutes from Kyoto Station: a small specialty stand pouring its own Nishijin-roasted beans plus rotating guest roasters, with well-liked matcha lattes. Of the Kurasu shops it's the one to visit; Ebisugawa sells home-brew equipment only (no espresso machine), and the third is a roastery café in Fushimi.

Name: Weekenders Coffee
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区蛸薬師通室町西入姥柳町189
Notes: A pioneer of Kyoto's light-roast scene, pouring clean single-origin pour-overs and espresso. Older guides send you to its tiny machiya behind a coin parking lot on Tominokoji; it moved here, to Shinmachi, in September 2026.

Name: Goodman Roaster
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区矢田町115-2 ベアフルートイイノ1F
Notes: A light-roast specialist best known for rare Taiwanese coffees, especially Alishan beans with cherry and oolong notes, served as hand drip. A spare, low-key space behind a yellow-and-glass storefront.

Name: Wife&Husband
Hours: 10:00–17:00 (café last order 16:30, picnic baskets last start 15:00); closed irregularly (see Instagram)
Address (JA): 京都府京都市北区小山下内河原町106-6
Notes: A couple-run café in a renovated old house filled with antiques. On sunny days they rent out picnic baskets (coffee, cups, sweets and folding stools) for the riverbank, booked ahead in 90-minute slots and cancelled if it rains.

Name: walden woods kyoto
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区栄町508-1
Notes: An all-white minimalist café known for its tiered 'white forest' staircase seating. Order the light-roast single-origin Ethiopian coffee with a matcha canelé or a Wolf Cookie.

Name: Fuku Coffee Roastery
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市東山区宮川筋八丁目
Notes: A small machiya roastery selling seven to ten beans, light to dark, with dark roasts its strength, plus ¥500 hand-drip coffee. Takeout only, no seating.

Name: solkatt coffee kyoto
Hours: 9:00–17:00; closed Mondays (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday)
Address (JA): 京都府京都市南区四ツ塚町53
Notes: A tiny coffee bar opened in 2024 in the owner's father's former bike shop, with a view of Toji's pagoda. The five-item menu is built on rotating seasonal single origins; choose your bean for the drip.

Name: Geshary Coffee Raku
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市東山区金園町
Notes: A café built around Geisha-variety coffee, in a house over 100 years old with a basement under a pond, a garden annex, a tea room and garden seats. Besides the coffee there are Geisha drinks, desserts and light sandwiches. Its other shop is in Hibiya, Tokyo.

Name: Le Labo Kyoto Machiya
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区木屋町通四条上る2丁目下樵木町206
Notes: Le Labo's flagship, opened in 2024 in a 145-year-old machiya renovated by Schemata Architects. The café, reached through a garden, serves coffee, tea drinks and vegan desserts to take away.

Name: here
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市中京区姉西洞院町
Notes: An espresso bar known for its lattes, the roasted-nut mocha above all, and for canelés in unusual flavors. The menu is just coffee and canelés.

Name: Gen Yamamoto
Address (JA): ~東京都港区麻布十番一丁目
Notes: Closest to a tasting-menu cocktail experience: a 4–7 drink omakase structured like kaiseki, each built around one peak-season Japanese ingredient (e.g., naruto kintoki sweet potato, hozuki). Minimalist, no music, ~8 seats. Reserve.

Name: Mixology Laboratory
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区八重洲一丁目
Notes: Shuzo Nagumo's lab-style bar: smoke-filled bags over martini glasses, salt rims turned to foam, tea and spice infusions. The most Aviary-like technique play in Tokyo.

Name: Bar Benfiddich
Address (JA): ~東京都新宿区西新宿一丁目
Notes: Hiroyasu Kayama grows herbs on his family farm, grinds botanicals by mortar at the counter, and makes his own absinthe, Campari and vermouth. No menu. World's 50 Best #44 (2026).

Name: The Bellwood
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区宇田川町
Notes: Menu structured like a kaiseki meal; e.g., a "Yakiniku Bloody" with smoked vodka and wagyu fat. A hidden sushi counter pairs omakase with three cocktails. Asia's 50 Best #79 (2026).

Name: Sodden Frog
Address (JA): 東京都港区虎ノ門5-10-7 麻布台ヒルズ ガーデンプラザD 3F
Notes: A bar where Shinnosuke Takada works with savory Japanese ingredients: nori, rice koji, seasonal vegetables.

Name: Bar Libre
Address (JA): ~東京都豊島区西池袋五丁目
Notes: Asia's 50 Best #39 (2026): classic forms built on Japanese ingredients (yuzu, shiso kombucha, Asian pear, myoga, shishito), with liquid nitrogen and smoke. Or pick a spirit and flavors, and they'll make you something bespoke.

Name: Folklore
Address (JA): ~東京都千代田区内幸町一丁目
Notes: A team in lab coats doing sake-, shochu- and whisky-based experiments, e.g., sweet potato shochu blends.

Name: Bar Ishinohana
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区渋谷三丁目
Notes: Technique with Japanese flavors: Hakushu whisky infused with shiitake for 36 hours, green tea old fashioned.

Name: Banten
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区恵比寿南一丁目
Notes: Cocktails built on Japanese spirits, developed with the team behind Kyoto's Nokishita 711. Music-focused listening bar.

Name: Bar Trench
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区恵比寿西一丁目
Notes: Absinthe and herbal liqueurs, esoteric old bar books, originals like Nikka coffee gin with sparkling sake. Asia's 50 Best #53 (2026). Sister bar Bar Tram is nearby.

Name: The SG Club
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区神南一丁目
Notes: Shingo Gokan's multi-floor bar; the downstairs "Sip" room is the serious cocktail floor (upstairs "Guzzle" is casual).

Name: Punch Room Tokyo
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区銀座二丁目
Notes: Japan's highest entry on Asia's 50 Best 2026 (#23). Historic punch formats rebuilt with Japanese spirits, sake, tea and spices. Hotel bar, but the drinks are carefully built.

Name: Virtù
Address (JA): ~東京都千代田区大手町一丁目
Notes: Asia's 50 Best #26 (2026). Vintage French spirits combined with sake, shochu and retro Japanese liqueurs; house umeshu aging room. Lots of atmosphere, but the drinks hold up.

Name: OCHER
Address (JA): ~東京都世田谷区北沢二丁目
Notes: A tea-and-spice bar that opened in July 2026, a minute from Shimokitazawa Station: chai cocktails built on hojicha, matcha or Japanese black tea. ¥800 cover.

Name: Bar High Five
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区銀座五丁目
Notes: Hidetsugu Ueno's legendary bar: no menu, he builds a drink from your preferences. Classic Japanese technique rather than experimental, but worth it as the benchmark.

Name: Nokishita 711
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区仙洞町235 Atsumari-B
Notes: The best Aviary-style pick in Kyoto: Tomoyuki Sekine's "liquid cuisine", a five-cocktail flight with a snack paired to each, built on foraged and local botanicals. Reservation only, with just four or so seats.

Name: The Roots of All Evil
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区烏丸通七条下ル東塩小路町721-1 京都タワービル B1F
Notes: Sekine's casual sister bar: herbal, earthy drinks like "The Root" (burdock-infused gin, ginger ale, herbs, cucumber). Cheap (¥800–1,500) and convenient near the station.

Name: Bee's Knees
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区神谷町364 マツヤビル1F
Notes: Hidden speakeasy that has appeared on Asia's 50 Best; drinks based on classics with a Japanese sensibility.

Name: Bar Rocking Chair
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区御幸町通仏光寺下る橘町434-2
Notes: Well-regarded relaxed bar known for carefully made seasonal cocktails; has appeared on Asia's 50 Best.

Name: Bar K6
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区二条通木屋町東入ル東生洲町481 ヴァルズビル2F
Notes: Kyoto institution for precise classics and Japanese craft spirits.

Name: L'Escamoteur
Hours: 20:00-02:00 (an English guide says to 01:00); closed Mondays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区西石垣通四条下ル斎藤町138-9 2F
Notes: Magic/alchemy-themed bar with theatrical serves. Leans more on showmanship than you might want; optional.

Name: Ista Coffee Elements
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市中央区北久宝寺町2-6-1 アドーラブルビルディング1F
Notes: Probably the most Aviary-like idea in Osaka: Fumiaki Nozato, a coffee-cocktail champion, uses the whole coffee plant (cherries, flowers, roasted leaves) and roasts beans in-house. The "Tea Experience" is served as a whisked matcha ceremony. Check evening hours.

Name: Craftroom
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市北区梅田1-3-1 大阪駅前第一ビル B2-70
Notes: Ryu Fujii, the 2016 Diageo World Class global runner-up, mixes inventive originals and reworked classics. It's the first Osaka bar on Asia's 50 Best: #28 in 2024, #58 in 2025 and #72 in 2026.

Name: Bar Nayuta
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-6-17 マリオビル5F
Notes: No menu: describe what you like and get a custom drink built from house-made infusions, bitters and liqueurs. Asia's 50 Best #70 (2026).

Name: Upstairz
Hours: Bar 14:00-24:00 (last order 23:30), open daily; smart casual
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市北区堂島浜1-4-26 ゼンティス大阪 2F
Notes: Norihiko Furuse's originals built on fruit, herbs and shochu, e.g., Wasabi Smash (wasabi, shiso, orgeat, tequila, gin). Won the Refreshing Challenge at the 2022 World Class Japan final.

Name: Lamp Bar
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市角振町26 いせやビル1F
Notes: Michito Kaneko's bar; Asia's 50 Best #94 (2026). He gives each guest his full attention, so you may wait in the entry until a seat opens. Considered among Japan's best outside Tokyo.
